scope: Read-only sysfs diagnostics; no model execution or performance qualification

real_sysfs_smoke.interpretation: Idle smoke capture only. It cannot explain earlier benchmark behavior or establish measurement overhead during active inference.

limitations: Non-atomic raw sysfs readings, not per-kernel GPU time or decoded throttle state
Internal read deadlines need an external timeout for blocking OS calls
Inter-sample sleep is added after sample completion, not a fixed-rate schedule
Future instrumented runs must remain diagnostic and separate from a004 and vendor qualification
